text:
Assistant A is more concise and better aligned with the request to explain the concept simply for a non-technical audience. It directly answers both parts of the question and correctly mentions that language models predict the next word and can use unlabeled data, though its explanation of labeled data is somewhat muddled. Assistant B is more detailed but overly technical and, more importantly, gives an inaccurate final answer: it says language models are trained using labeled input-output pairs, whereas core language model training is typically self-supervised on unlabeled text. Therefore, Assistant A is the better response.

[[A]]
